name: Pope Pius VI
role: Head of the Catholic Church from 1775 to 1799
contribution: Head of the Catholic Church and leader of the Papal States from 15 February 1775 to his death in August 1799.

checks.lead: Pope Pius VI (Italian: Pio VI; born Count Angelo Onofrio Melchiorre Natale Giovanni Antonio called Giovanni Angelo or Giannangelo Braschi, 25 December 1717 – 29 August 1799) was head of the Catholic Church and leader of the Papal States from 15 February 1775 to his death in August 1799.
